headline: Buy The Molina Dip: CMS Proposes Flat Medicare Advantage Increases For 2027
Molina Healthcare Workforce Push Tests Margins And Long Term Valuation
summary: Molina Healthcare (NYSE:MOH) announced a workforce development initiative to train and hire 15,000 home health aides. The program spans 26 states and focuses on free, accessible training and career pathways in home based care. headline: Humana, UnitedHealth, and CVS Stocks Plunge After Medicare Rates Blow
summary: Health-insurance stocks were plummeting Tuesday after the Trump administration proposed keeping Medicare rates roughly flat next year.  The plunge could overshadow the company’s fourth-quarter earnings, due at 10:55 a.m. Eastern time.  CVS Health  stock plummeted 8.9% and  Humana  tumbled 12.4%.
